name: Heart Throbbing School Days
source:
Welcome to Hoes Peak Academy! You've been accepted by a raffle, how lucky! Sure, the other people here might be actually talented, skillful, and super hot. Wait, what? GodDAMN look at those girls! From Kyoko to Kaede, you know you're not gonna stop until you get them all. It's time to earn your place, and become the king of Hoes Peak Academy.

[From [url=https://danganman.itch.io/heart-throbbing-school-days]Itch.io[/url]]
